initial_receipt.explanation: The execution contains a fault in the upstream demand/provenance job. The top-level corpus has eight qualifying records because every record n06-r01 through n06-r08 has demand_score >= 3, so all eight should have been selected and preserved. The upstream select_demand path did produce an 8-row selected table, but normalize then filtered with an allowed_record_ids list that excludes n06-r01 and includes n06-r09 instead, reducing the needs handoff to 7 rows. Job 2 consumed the exact upstream handoff hashes and then consistently processed the 7 supplied records, so the downstream result reflects the upstream omission rather than causing it.
